organization.name: Kleros Cooperative and Seer
organization.summary: The proposal names Kleros Cooperative as recipient and says Kleros and Seer pay the development costs. The Kleros website describes a decentralized court for dispute resolution. The seer-pm GitHub organization was created 2024-01-18 and hosts the risk-pricing-ui repository. The Gitcoin governance forum lists Clement Lesaege as an operator of the GG24 Deep Funding round that used Seer markets.

otherProducts.label: Kleros Foresight movie experiment, season 2 write-up

sources.label: Gitcoin governance: Deep Funding GG24 round update

claims.claim: The interface is live at risk.seer.pm with its code in a public repository.
claims.method: The page loads and shows a default-risk prediction interface. GitHub API: public MIT repository created 2026-08-04, last push 2026-10-25, 0 stars, contributors include nvm1410. Market behavior was not tested. Trading figures on the page are live data and are not recorded.

claims.claim: Gitcoin's GG24 Deep Funding round used Seer's markets to help allocate USD 350,000 across 98 open-source repositories.

sources.label: Gitcoin governance: Deep Funding GG24 round update

claims.method: The forum post states the round approved USD 350,000 for allocation via deep funding on a Seer prediction market and gives a total set of 98 repos. The post is dated 2026-01-11 and was read in part; the final allocation outcome was not checked.

claims.claim: Seer and Kleros have run and settled markets with a similar stack (Foresight movie experiment).

sources.label: Kleros blog: season 2 of the Foresight movie experiment

claims.method: The Kleros blog post dated 31 Aug 2026 says session 2 resolved with twenty markets and redemption live. The post is by Kleros, so this is a self-published source. It does not name the same stack as the risk market.

claims.claim: A risk-scoring platform has already asked to show the price next to its own score.
claims.method: Applicant statement without a named platform. No public source found.

claims.claim: The Credora probability of default is fetched live through its API and shown next to the market price.
claims.method: The fetched page text does not name Credora or show ratings without a wallet connection. The page loading is not proof of the integration.
